subject: Renewal onboarding sprint + QBR time options (term & capacity)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moro <elena@finlytics.com>; Finlytics Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal onboarding sprint + QBR time options (term & capacity)

Hi Elena (and Raj / procurement),

Thanks again for a productive renewal discussion last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short onboarding sprint to align on three things ahead of the formal renewal: 1) term amendment options, 2) capacity uplift forecast and gating, and 3) scheduling a QBR to present the proposed amendment and commercials.

High-level proposal:
- Timeline: 2-week coordination sprint (May 9 – May 22) to lock on terms and capacity numbers; formal amendment to follow.
- Stakeholders:
  - Finlytics: Elena (primary), Raj (procurement)
  - Redwood: Laura (technical), Ben (commercial), myself (AE & exec sign-off)
- Deliverables by May 22: draft amendment for review, updated capacity forecast, proposed runbook for migration/scale testing.

To keep scheduling lightweight, I created a quick poll with three QBR windows (please indicate availability): https://doodle.com/poll/rdw-finlytics-qbr-2029-05. Proposed QBR agenda (high level): kickoff + context (10m), usage & capacity review (20m), commercial terms & options (20m), open items & next steps (10m).

Attachments I’ve dropped here for context: RDW-draft-amendment-v1.pdf (template amendment with term/price placeholders) and capacity-forecast-template.xlsx (to capture workload buckets & projected token usage).

As next steps, can Raj confirm procurement checklist items they’ll need from us? Laura—can you lead the technical deep-dive and propose 2x 45-min slots for the week of May 13 for an architecture walkthrough? Ben—can you prepare an initial amendment sketch (pricing bands + credit windows) by EOW May 13?

Open to any changes—happy to tighten this up in a brief sync.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]

[attachment: RDW-draft-amendment-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: capacity-forecast-template.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Elena Moro <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finlytics Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding sprint + QBR time options (term & capacity)

Karthik,

Thanks — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. Raj and I will run the internal procurement checklist and loop in legal if there are any redlines.

A few quick notes from our side:
- Capacity: we'll likely request a staged uplift (30% initial uplift, then additional capacity after three months depending on latency/throughput results).
- Term: we prefer a 12 → 24 month option with a mid-term volume review and a step-down pricing mechanism for sustained usage.
- Security/hosting: can you confirm whether the private deployment option (VPC) is still available for the expanded workload? We’ll need that for our compliance team.

I’ve attached our procurement checklist for reference. I filled a few fields already.

I’ll also ask Raj to answer the poll — thanks for setting that up.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform Engineering | Finlytics
elena@finlytics.com

[attachment: finlytics-procurement-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moro <elena@finlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding sprint + QBR time options (term & capacity)

Elena / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two quick commits from our side:

1) Private/VPC: yes — private deployment is an option. I'll pull in the Private team notes and a one-pager that outlines network requirements and typical lead time (sending after this thread).
2) Commercial sketch: attached is a high-level pricing band model we can iterate on. It assumes an initial uplift + staged commit, with an option to convert staged capacity into a reserved pool if utilization hits the threshold we’ll agree on during the QBR.

Proposed timeline (concrete):
- May 9–13: capture capacity details (Finlytics) + Redwood prepares provisional amendment + security/VPC notes
- May 14–17: technical walkthroughs (Laura to run)
- May 20: QBR (finalize commercial approach; preferred window from Doodle listed)
- May 22: Redwood sends final amendment for signature

I can own the commercial sketch and the price bands; Karthik will manage exec approval and sign-off. Laura — can you confirm availability for May 15 & May 16 (45-min) for the architecture walkthrough?

Thanks — attaching: RDW-pricing-bands-v1.xlsx (work-in-progress).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Renewal & GTM Ops | Redwood Inference

[attachment: RDW-pricing-bands-v1.xlsx (Excel)]

Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding sprint + QBR time options (term & capacity)

Thanks everyone — quick sync and next steps after the poll results: 

Summary of agreed actions:
- Finlytics (Elena / Raj): confirm capacity buckets in the attached forecast and mark preferred QBR times in the Doodle by EOD May 10. Confirm whether VPC/on-prem is required for the uplift.
- Redwood (Ben): finalize pricing bands and prepare an amendment draft by May 13; include staged commit + conversion path language.
- Redwood (Laura): technical deep-dive to run on May 15 or 16 (once poll confirms) — focus on scaling KV cache, latency SLOs, and testing plan for staged uplift.
- Karthik: coordinate exec sign-off and provide a single slide commercial summary for the QBR.

If nothing else, I’ll lock the QBR on Monday morning once we have poll results and send a calendar invite with the agenda & pre-reads. Looking forward to moving this quickly.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]
